role: The brewing stand: a tile-entity block with a 4-slot inventory, a brewing timer the GUI drives, and a comparator output from the filled-bottle mask.
scope_reason: In scope: blaze rods from Nether fortresses make the stand craftable; placing it creates and ticks TileEntityBrewingStand (pickblock-s1), entities collide with its base and rod, and breaking it spills. world.conf brewing = off only closes the window (BlockBrewingStand.java:80) and stops the brew (TileEntityBrewingStand.java:100).

members.name: field_149961_a
members.note: The Block singleton's own Random (brewing stand [BR_BREWING_STAND]): det.nbt records it (BlockRands.java), serverreplay_load sets it, a --from run restores it.

members.name: createNewTileEntity
members.note: tileentity.c:217 maps 117 to TE_BREWING_STAND with 4 fresh slots.

members.name: addCollisionBoxesToList
members.note: the centre rod, then the 1/8 base: rs-mach-s1 walks the player into a stand, up onto its base and against its rod (it failed at row 195 on a full cube); the client's own item and orb copies reach it through their onUpdate's func_145771_j query (pickobj.c copy_brewing_touch, pfc-brewbounds-f356)

members.name: setBlockBoundsForItemRender
members.note: the base the collision query leaves as the one BlockBrewingStand object's bounds (collide.c brewing_base), which Block's getCollisionBoundingBoxFromPool (collide_pool_box) and the ray trace (raytrace.c block_bounds) read until the JVM ends; Snapshot.java records it in worldstate blockBounds and serverreplay.c restores it

members.name: onBlockActivated
members.note: world.conf brewing = off: false, so the held stack's use runs (iu-off-s1: dirt placed against it, nothing opens)

members.name: breakBlock
